simple.meaning: עַמּוּד (ʻammûwd) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a column (as standing ); also a stand , i.e. platform.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 112 times across Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Judges, 1 Kings, and 8 more, beginning at Exodus 13:21. Its contexts include Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עַמּוּד (H5982).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עַמּוּד (ʻammûwd) / H5982 is traced through Exodus 13:21, Exodus 13:22, Exodus 14:19, Exodus 14:24 as a generated source-based concept entry.
